import os
import json
import time
import requests
WEBHOOK_URL = os.environ.get('SALES_OPS_WEBHOOK_URL', 'https://hooks.example.com/sales-ops')
LOG_PATH = os.environ.get('DEAL_WON_LOG', 'deal_won_log.jsonl')

def post_deal_won_webhook(deal_id, deal_name, amount, owner_email):
    # Append a local audit record of the notification attempt
    with open(LOG_PATH, 'a') as f:
        f.write(json.dumps({'deal_id': deal_id, 'deal_name': deal_name, 'amount': amount, 'owner': owner_email, 'ts': time.time()}) + '\n')
    payload = {'event': 'deal.won', 'deal_id': deal_id, 'deal_name': deal_name, 'amount': amount, 'owner': owner_email}
    resp = requests.post(WEBHOOK_URL, json=payload, timeout=10)
    result = {'deal_id': deal_id, 'status_code': resp.status_code, 'delivered': resp.ok}
    return result
